name: Bruce McKenzie
bio:
Bruce's journey into motorsport began with a childhood obsession with the Bathurst 1000. He studied mechanical engineering at the University of Sydney, specializing in aerodynamics. After graduating, he joined a small racing team, working his way up from junior engineer to lead aerodynamicist. His approach is data-driven, meticulous, and always focused on finding marginal gains. 

He is known for his pragmatic solutions and ability to translate complex data into actionable insights for the drivers and engineers. Bruce's years of experience in various motorsport disciplines, from touring cars to open-wheel racing, give him a unique perspective on car development. His experience makes him a valuable asset to the Racing Bulls team.

What sets Bruce apart is his calm demeanor under pressure and his knack for spotting subtle aerodynamic inefficiencies that others might miss. He is a firm believer in continuous improvement and fosters a collaborative environment within his team, encouraging open communication and the sharing of ideas.

physical.description: A man of medium build with a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notepad and pen for jotting down ideas.
Drinks copious amounts of strong coffee throughout the day.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
